English Language Requirements
All applicants to Trinity are required to provide official evidence of proficiency in the English language.
The table below shows the standardised English proficiency tests accepted at Trinity, with scores required divided into bands. The majority of undergraduate and postgraduate courses accept Band B. Please see our course website for exact requirements for each course.
Please refer to the notes below the table for additional important information.
If you are using a mobile device, please scroll to the right on the table to see further information.

Notes
1. Applicants wishing to be admitted into undergraduate or postgraduate courses who do not meet the band requirement can apply for the CELLT Pre-Sessional Summer Programme.
2. For all proficiency tests, the results must be issued within two years prior to the start of your course.
3. Requirements refer to Duolingo Integrated Scores. If presenting Duolingo Test of English, applicants must share their test score with institution "Trinity College Dublin, The University of Dublin" from the Duolingo website.
4. Applicants for postgraduate courses who have completed a primary degree through the medium of English may request an exemption from the requirement to present an English proficiency qualification. Exemptions will only be considered if the application is otherwise complete and submitted. The applicant must provide a formal document from the awarding institution clearly stating their prior degree was delivered wholly through English. Requests for exemption should be made to the course director/coordinator. Exemption requests approved by the course director/coordinator will be considered by the Admissions Team.
5. TOEFL iBT Home Edition is accepted with the same score conditions as the standard TOEFL iBT.
6. IELTS single subject retake is accept
7. The following 2nd level qualifications will also be accepted as evidence of proficiency in the English language:
Irish Leaving Certificate
A grade 6 or better in Ordinary or Higher Level English
GCSE
A grade C/5 or better in English Language
European Baccalaureate
English: 6 in your 1st language, or in 1st or 2nd Foreign Language
QQI/FETAC
Pass in Communications module (5N0690)
French Baccalaureate
Students presenting the OIB or International Option of the French Baccalaureate may satisfy the English language requirement by achieving a minimum of 12 (where the coefficient is greater than 5) in English Language and Literature. In cases where the coefficient is less than 5, a minimum result of 14 will be required.
International Baccalaureate
English A1, A2 or B: SL4 if presenting IB through English, HL5 if presenting through French or Spanish.
US High School Curriculum
A grade C in English taken in final year. This applies to students who have completed their full second level education at a US High School.
Hong Kong, HKDSE
Level 4 or better in English Language.
Malaysia, SPM
Grade C or better in English 1119.
For any queries on Trinity’s English language requirements, please contact Academic Registry through AskTCD using the ‘Log an Academic Registry Enquiry’ button.
In subject line please include “FAO Admissions – English requirements”.
